# Francisco Goya — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Francisco Goya known for?", "The Third of May"),
    ("What field did Francisco Goya work in?", "Romantic"),

    ("What is field?", "Romantic"),

    ("What is note?", "Court painter turned prophet of horror"),
]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
